    def initialize_correction(self, mode: str) -> None:
        # Called only after every original model parameter has been initialized.
        self.correction_mode = mode
        if mode == "baseline":
            return
        hidden_units = self.conv1.in_channels
        self.short_conv1 = nn.Conv1d(hidden_units, hidden_units, self.kernel_size)
        self.short_conv2 = nn.Conv1d(hidden_units, hidden_units, self.kernel_size)
        self.short_norm1 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_units)
        self.short_norm2 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_units)
        self.alpha = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(()))
        if mode == "content":
            self.gate = nn.Linear(hidden_units, hidden_units)
            nn.init.zeros_(self.gate.bias)
        else:
            self.gate_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(hidden_units))

    def _causal_conv(self, conv: nn.Conv1d, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        pad = (conv.kernel_size[0] - 1) * conv.dilation[0]
        return conv(nn.functional.pad(x, (pad, 0)))

    def _update(self, x, mask, norm1, conv1, norm2, conv2):
        # LayerNorm operates on channels at each timestep. Mask its affine
        # offsets before convolution so left padding cannot become context.
        y = (norm1(x) * mask).transpose(1, 2)
        y = self._causal_conv(conv1, y).transpose(1, 2) * mask
        y = self.dropout(self.activation(y)) * mask
        y = (norm2(y) * mask).transpose(1, 2)
        y = self._causal_conv(conv2, y).transpose(1, 2) * mask
        return self.dropout(y) * mask

    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor, valid: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        mask = valid.unsqueeze(-1).to(dtype=x.dtype)
        x = x * mask
        base = self._update(x, mask, self.norm1, self.conv1, self.norm2, self.conv2)
        result = x + base
        if self.correction_mode != "baseline":
            short = self._update(x, mask, self.short_norm1, self.short_conv1,
                                 self.short_norm2, self.short_conv2)
            if self.correction_mode == "content":
                gate = torch.sigmoid(self.gate(x))
            else:
                gate = torch.sigmoid(self.gate_bias)
            result = result + self.alpha * gate * (short - base)
        return result * mask
